t: This is the African and Caribbean War Memorial in Brixton, the United Kingdom's national memorial to African and Caribbean service personnel who fought in both World Wars. It grew out of a plan to honour Caribbean RAF veterans who arrived on the Empire Windrush in 1948. It was designed by Jak Beula, founder of the Nubian Jak Community Trust, which has marked the contributions of Black people in Britain since 2006. It was first meant for Tilbury Docks, but the project grew into a wider tribute.
